I have been an OLMC parishioner since 2019. I am an usher and on the safety team and am a fourth degree knight, in the honor guard and the grand knight for our council.
I have a great team of local lenders and home inspectors and my relationship with the best title companies in the state provides my clients the best services available. I am part of Real Estate For Life, which is a national non-profit organization that donates 25% of my commissions to pro life causes. With my 33 years of experience working with other agents, lenders, home inspectors, buyers, sellers, foreclosures, short sales, etc and having an expert knowledge of the metro Denver housing market, you will have a real estate sales experience second to none.
